description: Prepare a job for the person to post on Energy North: returns a link that opens the Energy North post-a-job form already filled with the trade, postcode and job details, so local verified tradespeople can reply. The person checks the details and posts it themselves; nothing is posted by this tool.

details.description: What needs doing, in the person's words, up to 1000 characters.

postcode.description: UK postcode of the job, if known, e.g. "N11 1AB".

name: post_a_job
title: Prepare a job post
